title: Crimson's Laptop of Undying
description: replaces the totem with a laptop :D
body:
Replaces the default totem of undying with a laptop :D. Works in **1.21.9** and **1.21.10**. Might work in versions **1.21.6** and above. I made it invisible when in the offhand so it doesn't obstruct the view while the player is fighting.

THIS TEXTURE PACK IS MADE FOR **CRIMSON ASH SMP**

This texture pack can also be used in other servers or in singleplayer.
